title: Continuation procedure for Deployment work
summary: Continue from the current dev4 candidate plus the last full dev3 r13196 baseline. For production dependency work, inspect current SSC qualified deployment/package contracts first, preserve exact sealed dependency ids, materialise a deterministic target namespace, and only then perform package-load/host/application verification. Keep DEVELOPMENT/LEGACY_INTAKE semantics explicitly separate.
invariants: Do not let the first consumer turn into permanent Audio-specific behavior in Deployment.
For production release dependencies, prefer current SSC QUALIFIED sealed deployments and exact dependency deployment ids.
Never replace source.get_deployment_package/getDeploymentPackage sealed semantics with floating development resolution.
Materialise exact package bytes into a deterministic namespace and use the same generated REXX_PATH for qualification and launch.
A hosted-module change must be exercised with a real host/package composition, not only a fake route class.
A native repair change must exercise both reuse and rebuild/fail-closed paths.
A concurrency change must prove same-target single-flight and independent-target parallelism.
Promote a new executable baseline only with explicit runtime qualification evidence; update package hash, sphere and continuity together.

procedure: Resolve/load the oorexx-deployment sphere; read start, qualification, known-gaps, ssc-sealed-deployments and dependency-namespace.
Verify both the current candidate hash and the last full runtime-qualified baseline hash.
Inspect current SSC repository/service contracts before modifying dependency semantics.
Classify dependency mode as SEALED, DEVELOPMENT or LEGACY_INTAKE.
For SEALED, obtain exact qualified deployment/dependency ids and sealed package output without floating.
Materialise the closure into a deterministic target namespace and record exact REXX_PATH.
Run ooRexx/shell tests and real consumer qualification appropriate to the changed boundary.
Package executable and sphere separately; update Rasen Falcon lane/message and Git provenance.
